dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency distribution of diffuse grey patches across the dorsal surface, becoming more concentrated toward the posterior.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between the light-grey baseline and darker pigmented patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint linear rake marks and small dark spots visible on the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scratches and faint rake marks distributed across the mid-to-posterior dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, sharp dorsal ridge creating a distinct longitudinal contrast line along the central axis.
